newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT's Leykam unit sees good demand.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT's Leykam unit sees good demand.

text.p: Dutch NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Thursday its paper division KNP Leykam expected healthy demand in the second half of this year, but added profit margins would be pressured due to rising raw material costs.

"It is uncertain whether the rise in paper prices, which is planned for the second half of this year, will offer sufficient compensation for this (rising raw material costs)," the company said in a statement.

Given this trend and start-up costs for KNP Leykam's new production unit in Austria, KNP BT said it expected no substantial change in Leykam's results in the second 1997 half, adding these would remain under pressure.
In the first half of 1997 KNP Leykam posted operating profits of 22 million guilders, up from a loss of 24 million guilders in the year-ago period.
Last year, the Dutch paper and office equipment group said it was seeking a partner for KNP Leykam.
